purpose: Define who EUCONS should serve first, the real job each organization is trying to complete, which lawful public signals indicate timing, which canonical service fits, what must be verified, and how the organization may be acquired without presenting inference as eligibility.

truth_model.rule: FACT requires evidence; material funding facts require an official source or a verified PARTENER projection. INFERENCE never becomes eligibility. HYPOTHESIS remains outside public claims and performance reporting until validated.
truth_model.performance_rule: No market-size, conversion, demand-volume or revenue metric is asserted without real telemetry or an authoritative source.
truth_model.privacy_rule: Prospecting begins at organization level. Prefer official/public organization and role-based business-contact surfaces; do not infer sensitive traits or use private-person data.

market_facts.statement: AFIR exposes public session, selection, contract and beneficiary surfaces that can support organization-level opportunity and post-award signals.
AFIR procedural material explicitly treats consulting, monitoring and project management as project preparation and implementation cost categories in the applicable rural-funding context.
Current SEAP public notices include EU-funded requirements for project management, implementation support, supervision or audit, demonstrating a lawful public signal surface for institutional demand.

Eurostat reported Romania at 27% of SMEs reaching at least basic digital intensity in the referenced 2024 edition; the observation supports a digital-investment research lane but does not prove funding eligibility or purchase intent for any organization.

The European Commission's 2025 Romania country-report process assesses investment, employment, skills, social and reform challenges; these are macro context only and cannot be used as organization-level intent.
The EU Funding & Tenders Portal organization and partner-search model uses public organization and funded-project context, supporting an organization-history signal lane for direct EU programmes.

customer_segments.label: IMM-uri, companii și antreprenori
customer_segments.inclusion: Organization has a defined investment, growth, digitalization, energy, production, tourism, rural or workforce-development need.
exclusions: No identifiable organization or investment context
Requested activity is outside EUCONS service registry
core_objections: Nu știu dacă investiția este eligibilă
Nu vreau să pregătesc documente înainte să existe o potrivire reală
Mă tem de cost, birocrație și obligațiile de după aprobare

customer_segments.label: Autorități și instituții publice
customer_segments.inclusion: Public organization has an evidenced investment pipeline, strategy, procurement, awarded project or implementation-capacity need.
exclusions: Political targeting without an organizational service need
No public source or authorized internal evidence for the trigger
core_objections: Avem nevoie de traseu procedural și responsabilități clare
Capacitatea internă este limitată sau fragmentată

customer_segments.label: Beneficiari cu proiecte contractate
customer_segments.inclusion: Organization has public or authorized evidence of an awarded/contracted project and a plausible implementation, reporting, procurement, financial or recovery job.
exclusions: A problem is inferred from silence or rumor
core_objections: Consultantul inițial ar trebui să se ocupe
Nu vreau să expun date confidențiale înainte de diagnostic
Problema poate necesita aprobare sau interpretare a autorității

customer_segments.label: ONG-uri și actori ai economiei sociale
customer_segments.inclusion: Nonprofit, foundation, association, social-economy entity or eligible partnership has a mission-aligned project, service, investment or awarded-project need.
exclusions: Mission and proposed activity are not sufficiently described
Eligibility class is assumed from legal form alone
core_objections: Echipa este concentrată pe misiune, nu pe administrare
Parteneriatele și grupul țintă complică proiectarea

customer_segments.label: Furnizori de formare și organizații cu nevoi de competențe
customer_segments.inclusion: Authorized or potential training provider, employer, chamber, school or partnership has a documented workforce/skills need or a relevant funding/project trigger.
exclusions: Authorization or delivery capacity is assumed
Learner demand is synthetic or unsupported
core_objections: Apelul poate cere parteneriate și indicatori greu de susținut
Documentarea orelor, rezultatelor și eligibilității este complexă

customer_segments.label: Actori agricoli, rurali și GAL
customer_segments.inclusion: Farm, rural SME, cooperative, producer group, GAL or rural partnership has an evidenced AFIR/GAL/investment or implementation trigger.
exclusions: Consultant-directory presence is treated as accreditation
An announced intervention is treated as an open call without official confirmation
core_objections: Condițiile tehnice și economice sunt greu de comparat
Implementarea și achizițiile pot depăși capacitatea internă

trigger_taxonomy.label: Oportunitate oficială relevantă
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Potential fit only; eligibility remains unknown until checked.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Investiție sau extindere anunțată public
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Possible need for funding strategy or application support.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Strategie, buget sau plan public adoptat
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Possible pipeline-planning need; procurement intent is not assumed.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Proiect selectat, contractat sau finanțat
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Possible post-award service need; implementation problems are not inferred.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Plan sau anunț de achiziție relevant
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Demand may exist only within the published procurement route and deadline.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Termen contractual sau de raportare apropiat
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Operational urgency only when the exact term and obligation are sourced.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Clarificare, constatare, modificare sau corecție documentată
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Recovery need may be recommended; outcome cannot be promised.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Nevoie publică de recrutare, formare sau competențe
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Possible training/project-capacity need; eligible target groups remain unknown.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Context sectorial de digitalizare redusă
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: Supports content and segment research, never account-level intent by itself.

trigger_taxonomy.label: Istoric public de proiecte sau finanțări
trigger_taxonomy.allowed_inference: May support organizational capability/next-project research, not current buying intent.

official call or verified PARTENER projection
search_intents: ce fonduri europene se potrivesc firmei mele

demand_matrix.job: Corelează nevoile și proiectele din strategie cu oportunități verificabile.
demand_matrix.recommended_next_action: Funding pipeline workshop and evidence-gap register.

demand_matrix.job: Pregătește o aplicație complexă și coordonează contribuțiile tehnice, financiare și administrative.

demand_matrix.job: Achiziționează și implementează suportul de proiect pe traseul procedural corect.

demand_matrix.recommended_next_action: Mission-to-programme fit map with capacity unknowns.

demand_matrix.job: Proiectează și implementează o intervenție socială fără supraîncărcarea echipei.
demand_matrix.recommended_next_action: Capacity and evidence diagnostic before scoping.

demand_matrix.job: Transformă o nevoie de competențe într-un proiect cu grup țintă și livrare demonstrabile.

evidence_needed: official AFIR/GAL guide and session state

demand_matrix.recommended_next_action: Portfolio capacity and next-investment fit review.

acquisition_hypotheses.statement: Post-award implementation and recovery journeys will produce higher-intent leads than generic funding-discovery traffic.
acquisition_hypotheses.validation_plan: Compare real qualified-lead rate and time-to-next-action by journey after telemetry is active; do not publish a superiority claim before data exists.

acquisition_hypotheses.statement: A short organization/project-intent first step will improve evaluation completion relative to the current all-at-once journey.
acquisition_hypotheses.validation_plan: Run consent-safe funnel measurement after live intake activation; compare completion and qualification, not raw starts alone.

acquisition_hypotheses.statement: Award plus procurement or deadline signals will prioritize implementation prospects better than award evidence alone.
acquisition_hypotheses.validation_plan: Back-test on labeled non-evidence fixtures, then validate against human-reviewed prospect outcomes without treating score as eligibility.

acquisition_hypotheses.statement: Proof adjacent to the visitor's job will increase trust and qualified CTA conversion.
acquisition_hypotheses.validation_plan: Instrument case/service-assisted paths only after additional evidence objects are publishable; retain UNKNOWN if sample is insufficient.

acquisition_hypotheses.statement: CCI, professional and beneficiary networks may outperform broad social reach for institutional, training and implementation services.
acquisition_hypotheses.validation_plan: Track source-of-lead and qualified outcomes from real referrals/campaigns; no synthetic attribution.

product_implications.decision: Use the trigger taxonomy above as the demand-side input for Client Finder; preserve expiry and allowed-inference boundaries.
Create a distinct implementation/recovery public journey and internal prospect lane; do not bury it under generic services.
Start with organization, job and stage; request financial/technical detail only when needed for the selected path.
product_implications.dependency: R04 UX and R05 inbound runtime

product_implications.decision: Map publishable case evidence to the specific jobs it supports; do not use unrelated portfolio logos as proof.
Prospect records must carry organization identity, trigger, source, service candidate, missing checks, expiry and human-approved next action.
Measure qualified outcomes by job/segment/channel; all current commercial hypotheses remain UNKNOWN until real events exist.

decision.summary: Priority demand is organized into six operational segments and sixteen jobs. Client Finder should prioritize organization-level, time-bound signals, with the post-award beneficiary lane treated as a P0 commercial path.

next_unit.description: Reconcile the canonical service and evidence architecture against the demand model, identify missing service boundaries/proof mappings, and create provenance-addressable proof objects only where evidence supports them.
